title: DeckStudio plugin manifest (deckstudio.json, plugin/v1)
description: A small macOS tool exposed to the Stream Deck+ through DeckStudio. Spec: docs/PLUGINS.md. The authoritative validator is validateManifest in src/plugin-schema.mjs; this schema is for editors and authoring tools.

oneOf.description: A file in the plugin folder (served at /plugin-icon/<id>.<ext>).

builtin.description: Only for plugins shipped in DeckStudio's own plugins/ folder.

detect.description: Installed when any entry matches (no detect: always installed). The first bin found is $bin; the first installed bundle is the app.

bin.description: Executables: absolute, ~/ or $dir/ paths, or a bare name looked up on PATH (+ /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, ~/.local/bin, ~/bin).

paths.description: Files or folders whose existence means installed.

install.description: Shown to the user; DeckStudio never installs anything by itself.

bots.description: The plugin is also a bring-your-own-bots provider: this transport yields a bots/v1 document (docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md).

default.description: When the path finds nothing (or before the first read).

stale.description: While the status is stale (else default, else empty).

map.description: Exact text → shown text (true/false/numbers as text); with tests, applied to then / else.

above.description: Test: the number is > this. With tests the value shows then ("on") when every test holds, else else ("").

atLeast.description: Test: the number is ≥ this, e.g. { "path": "$.pct", "atLeast": 80 } lights a lamp from 80.

equals.description: Test: the value's text equals this.

templates.description: Become recipes (ids plugin-<id>-<name>), applied only while the plugin is on. {self.x} means {<id>.x}; { type: plugin } without plugin means this one. Presentation fields and actions of type plugin (this plugin only), page, back, none or a multi of those: no poll / browse commands, shell, applescript, keys, hold-keys, type, http, shortcut, open or app actions.

settings.description: What the user can change in the editor (saved in profile.plugins[id].settings, never in the manifest). {settings.<name>} in the plugin's argv (after argv[0]), urls, http bodies, action args, a status file path and value paths; $DECK_SETTINGS_<NAME> in the env; {<id>.settings.<name>} (templates: {self.settings.<name>}) on keys.

permissions.description: What the plugin asks for. Nothing here is granted until the user allows it (profile.plugins[id].grants).

shell.description: Shell-string commands, and argv whose program is a shell, interpreter or wrapper, or anything other than $bin / detect.bin / $dir/….

schemes.description: url schemes besides https its url actions open.

network.description: Hosts (host or host:port) besides 127.0.0.1 / localhost / [::1] for http status / actions.

path.description: JSONPath-lite: $, $.a.b, $.a[0], $.a[-1], $['odd key'], $.list.length; a bracket may hold a setting: $['{settings.target}']

oneOf.description: argv, run without a shell. argv[0]: "$bin", one of detect.bin, or "$dir/…" (a file shipped in the plugin); any other program needs permissions.shell and the user's grant. "$bin" is replaced only as a whole element. Later elements may use {value} {delta} {index} {page} {param} {id.value} {settings.name}.
A zsh -lc command: needs permissions.shell and the user's grant. Values come only as env ($DECK_VALUE, $DECK_BIN, $DECK_SETTINGS_<NAME>…); $bin isn't replaced.

http.description: GET; loopback only unless declared in permissions.network and granted. Redirects aren't followed.

file.description: A JSON (or text) file the tool rewrites (write a temp file, then rename). May start with a setting ({settings.status_file}). Missing: state stopped.

interval.description: Seconds (defaults: cmd 30, http 10, file 2). Polled at most every 30 s while nothing on the current page shows the plugin.

timeout.description: Seconds (default 10); the command's whole process group is killed.

stale.description: Seconds without a fresh read / heartbeat before the status is stale (default max(95, 3 × interval)). A document with running: false is stopped instead.

params.description: Args a key may pass ({ type: plugin, args: {…} }); usable as {name} in argv / urls, or merged into a builtin action. Arg strings are filled from this plugin's own vars ({id.value}, {id.settings.x}, {settings.x}) and the control's ({value}, {index}…), never another plugin's.

refresh.description: Re-read the status right after (default true).

timeout.description: Seconds: cmd actions up to 1800 (default 15; detached 1800), http actions up to 60 (default 10). The process group is killed after it.

detach.description: cmd actions only: start in the background, report started at once (long builds). Output: ~/.deckstudio/plugins-logs/<id>-<action>.log.

toast.description: Show the first line of output on the strip.

target.description: app: "bundle" (the detected app) or a bundle id.

url.description: https always; other schemes need permissions.schemes + the user's grant. Vars are URL-encoded; {name|path} keeps / between segments (no empty, . or .. segment).

builtin.description: Built-in plugins only: a DeckStudio action (capture → { type: capture, … }).

default.description: Must be of the setting's type.

secret.description: String settings only, no default: the value (an API token…) reaches only this plugin's own commands, urls and env; it is never a template var and never shown by /api/plugins or MCP.

additionalProperties.description: A key / dial / page object (docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md), or { title, what, template }.
